title: Shared experimental extension ari.goal
description: Goal runs: one objective that the provider pursues over several turns it starts on its own. Filled natively by some providers and derived from the transcript by others, marked `derived: true`. Drivers list `{ ns: "ari.goal", version: "1" }` in `capabilities.extensions`, emit `x:ari.goal.updated` events, and answer `session.ext("ari.goal", "get" | "set" | "clear", params)`.

derived.description: True when the driver read the goal from the transcript instead of a native goal API.

turnIds.description: Turns the goal run has owned so far.

AriGoalUpdatedEvent.description: Event body for a goal change.

data.description: The goal, or null once it is cleared.

AriGoalResult.description: Result of `get` and `set`: the goal, or null when none is set.
